name: docs-deployment-kubernetes-md-14
yaml:
replicaCount: 1

image:
  repository: zainalpour/rift-proxy
  tag: latest
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent

service:
  type: ClusterIP
  adminPort: 2525
  metricsPort: 9090

resources:
  limits:
    cpu: 1000m
    memory: 512Mi
  requests:
    cpu: 250m
    memory: 128Mi

config:
  allowInjection: true
  logLevel: info

imposters: |
  {
    "imposters": []
  }
